# NPM Improved v1.6.16 — Native Control-Plane Security Update

## Security update: Go crypto/x509

This maintenance release replaces the **actual native Go control-plane executable**, not just the NPMi version string. The inherited container base bundled a Go executable compiled with an older Go toolchain, so the October 19, 2026 crypto/x509 security fix (CVE-2026-111943) was not guaranteed to be present even after the NGINX and Node.js patches.

NPMi v1.6.16 rebuilds the native control-plane program with **Go 1.27.3**. It keeps the existing independent listener and re-applies the required `cap_net_bind_service` binary capability for deployments running under a restricted PUID.

## Security baseline retained

- **NGINX 1.31.8**, containing the October 14 security fixes added in v1.6.14.
- **Node.js 24.22.1**, containing the October 21 security fixes added in v1.6.15.
- **Go 1.27.3**, adding the October 19 crypto/x509 fix to the native control plane in this release.

## What does not change

- Existing proxy hosts, access lists, certificates, HTTPS routes, NPMX pairing/snapshot synchronization, database migration workflows, Control Center pages, and the host's in-place update/rollback lifecycle are preserved.
- No configuration reset, new database schema, or secret rotation is required by the source changes.
- Installed instances are **not** modified merely because a GitHub release exists: administrators must apply the update and confirm health.

## Upgrade instructions

1. Back up NPMi's persistent data, certificates, and any external database prior to upgrading.
2. In a paired NPMX deployment, update the secondary first using **Settings → Update**, validate its container and proxy routing, then update the primary. Match both nodes to v1.6.16 before treating cluster health as fully verified.
3. Confirm NGINX `nginx/1.31.8`, Node.js `24.22.1`, successful management API health, representative HTTPS hosts, and a fresh NPMX successful sync.
4. Retain the existing host-updater rollback path; do not assume source publication upgrades an installed container.

## Release validation

Publication is gated on the full production image build and existing Docker integration checks for patched NGINX/Node, NPMX, updater restart and database migration, plus multiarchitecture release-asset checksums. The control-plane build runs with Go 1.27.3 and its embedded module metadata is checked at build time.

- Go security announcement: https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/66pojueaQek
- Full changelog: https://github.com/gigabytegrove/npm-improved/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md
